episodes.synopsis: Students train at the Liebe Delta station; tensions and relationships are introduced before disaster strikes.

episodes.synopsis: A sabotage incident begins to destabilize the station, causing confusion and mistrust.

episodes.title: The Ring of Ryvius

episodes.synopsis: Students begin forming a fragile society aboard the Ryvius.
episodes.title: A Little Harmony

episodes.synopsis: A coup led by Blue takes control; the Vital Guarder weapon system is discovered.
episodes.title: My Moment

episodes.synopsis: Power struggles deepen as leadership fractures and factions form.
episodes.title: The Changing Times

episodes.synopsis: The crew struggles to understand the ship and their situation.

episodes.synopsis: The giant weapon is activated as external threats emerge.

episodes.synopsis: The Ryvius is attacked; it fights back but becomes a target of authorities and is forced to flee.

episodes.title: When the Party's Over

episodes.synopsis: The crew debates their direction and survival strategy.
episodes.title: Whereabouts of the Future

episodes.synopsis: Personal relationships intensify amid isolation.
episodes.title: If Only to Meet

episodes.synopsis: Class divisions and resentment worsen onboard.
episodes.title: To Be Too Conscious

episodes.synopsis: The Ryvius drifts further from help; morale declines.
episodes.title: Swept Away

episodes.synopsis: The ship’s internal society becomes increasingly unstable.
episodes.title: Deforming World

episodes.synopsis: Authority structures begin to collapse.
episodes.title: Free Order

episodes.synopsis: The survivors reflect on their failures and misunderstandings.
episodes.title: Incomprehensible

episodes.synopsis: Moments of humanity appear amid growing chaos.

episodes.synopsis: The crew becomes divided under harsh leadership.
episodes.title: We Don't Need Tomorrow

episodes.synopsis: Martial law intensifies as survival becomes the only priority.
episodes.title: In Order to Survive

episodes.synopsis: Characters confront their past actions and guilt.
episodes.title: Torn Past

episodes.synopsis: Kouji challenges Ikumi’s rule as outside forces close in.
episodes.title: Kouji Aiba

episodes.synopsis: Personal identity and choices come to the forefront.

episodes.title: Tomorrow
